text:
maya: Heads up — eu-west-2a cluster bring-up is hitting two simultaneous blockers. Provider-side BGP route flaps causing intermittent egress to our NATs, and the new GPU nodes are joining with label set `gpu_type: unknown` so the autoscaler and scheduler ignore them. Anyone seen this combo?

ahmed: saw the BGP flap in provider status page ~15m ago. I can confirm some pods show `ImagePullBackOff` and `node egress` errors.

liz: re: labels — looks like our node bootstrap script uses `/etc/node-labels.yaml` from the cloud-init, but the agent ran before we pushed the label template. nodes show `gpu:true` taint but no `gpu_type`.

sam: logs from the CNI on one problematic node: ```time="2026-03-18T10:12:03Z" level=error msg="BGP session reset: neighbor 10.2.0.1"``` plus `ip route` shows missing default via the NAT.

infra-bot: Deployment check: nodegroup eu-west-2a-gpu-01 created at 2026-03-18T10:05Z. 6 nodes registered, 4 Ready, 2 NotReady. Recent daemonset: calico 3.20.1 deployed 10:06Z.

sre-oncall: @maya @ahmed I can take lead. Immediate plan: 1) cordon the 2 NotReady nodes to avoid scheduling, 2) patch labels on Ready GPU nodes so autoscaler picks up, 3) coordinate with provider support on BGP flap and route flaps. Can someone run `kubectl get nodes -o wide` and `kubectl describe node <node>` for one NotReady node?

maya: running `kubectl get nodes -o wide` -> `eu2a-gpu-05 NotReady  10.2.5.12  3d  <none>  v1.27`

ahmed: `kubectl describe node eu2a-gpu-05` shows `NetworkUnavailable: condition false` and kubelet: `Failed to start CNI plugin: bgp session error`. Also `/var/log/cloud-init.log` shows our bootstrap failing to write labels: `FileNotFoundError: /etc/node-labels.yaml`.

liz: immediate workaround: patch node labels manually so pods schedule: `kubectl label node eu2a-gpu-05 gpu_type=rtx6000 --overwrite` and then uncordon when healthy. Also remove the taint temporarily: `kubectl taint nodes eu2a-gpu-05 node.kubernetes.io/no-schedule-`.

sam: doing that now on the 4 Ready nodes to let workloads drain less: `kubectl label node eu2a-gpu-{01,02,03,04} gpu_type=rtx6000 --overwrite` -> confirmed pods scheduled onto 01 and 02.

infra-bot: Action log: manual-label-patch by sam at 2026-03-18T10:25Z.

sre-oncall: Good. For the BGP/nat egress: provider acknowledged a control-plane BGP instability, they will roll a fix but ETA unknown. Short-term mitigation: switch affected nodes to our fallback public egress by reapplying the route table: `ip route replace default via 10.254.0.1 dev eth0` (requires infra sudo). @ahmed can you coordinate with cloud ops to push that?

ahmed: I opened support ticket #INC-20260318-84 with provider linking our calico logs. Also starting a rolling restart of the calico daemonset on NotReady nodes to re-establish sessions: `kubectl rollout restart ds/calico -n kube-system`.

maya: note for handoff: the bootstrap race (agent before label template) needs a runbook update — add a post-bootstrap check to verify `/etc/node-labels.yaml` exists before kubelet registration. I'll file a PR to infra-templates.

liz: also captured potential quota risk — the autoscaler wanted to pick extra nodes but hit vCPU soft quota in our account for eu-west-2. GPUs allowed but vCPU limit blocked scaling. We should request quota increase before next bring-up.

sam: summary checklist for oncall handoff: 1) Provider BGP incident open (INC-20260318-84) 2) Manual labels applied to Ready nodes 3) Cordon NotReady nodes eu2a-gpu-05, eu2a-gpu-06 4) Rolling restart of calico ds in progress 5) File PR to add post-bootstrap label-check + update autoscaler mapping 6) Quota request for vCPU submitted.

sre-oncall: I'll take ownership for the next 2 hours. If BGP persists after rolling calico, we'll rollback to previous CNI version 3.19.4 (it was stable in us-west). @maya please open a follow-up internal ticket for the runbook + templates and tag `infra-team`.

maya: will do — creating ticket INF-2026-042 and adding the logs/snippets. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sam: one more note — cost impact: manual labels allowed scheduling and a few burst pods started; monitor tokenized GPU-hour burn in the console, we might need to pause noncritical jobs until the network is stable.

infra-bot: Monitoring alert: increased egress error rate for eu-west-2a at 2026-03-18T10:32Z.

sre-oncall: updating incident channel and will post an aggregate update in 30m. If anyone sees new NotReady nodes, ping me directly.

maya: thanks — leaving logs and commands in INF-2026-042.
